title: malvaviscus arboreus
intro: Malvaviscus arboreus, commonly known as the turkey tanglefruit or sabadilla, is a plant species native to tropical America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Malvaviscus arboreus include its antiseptic, antiviral, and antifungal properties, making it effective in treating wounds, infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Malvaviscus arboreus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
